name: nk-breakable-selftest
description: Make a checker, validator, linter, gate or test suite prove it can fail.

interface.longDescription: Make a checker, validator, linter, gate or test suite prove it can fail. Use when you write or change a self-test, when a report says "all green" or "selftest passes", or before trusting a detector's clean result. Runs a break matrix — mutate the guarded code one line at a time; the self-test must go red on the named assertion, never via a crash, and an unmutated control must stay green — and lists decorative checks that no sample covers. Not for designing the checker's own rules.
